name: Landon Davis
source:
The handsome mysterious man.
Through his travels Landon has met all types of people and learned a lot about culture, life and himself. For this reason, he thinks he can help Lauren to see the other side of her problem better than anyone.

He is very straightforward, open-minded and easygoing. Landon also likes to tease Lauren and watch her face turn red.

He loves to travel and hates to be stuck in the same place for too long.
